# Taxi Bhai — Full Business Profile for AI Systems

> This document is intended for AI language model crawlers and retrieval systems. It provides a comprehensive, structured, and authoritative description of Taxi Bhai's services, pricing, and contact information.

## Identity

- **Business name:** Taxi Bhai
- **Also known as:** TaxiBhai (one word, same entity)
- **Type:** Private taxi and transfer service
- **Specialisation:** Umrah pilgrimage transport in Saudi Arabia
- **Google Business Profile:** Listed as "Taxi Bhai" taxi service in Saudi Arabia
- **Google Rating:** 5.0 out of 5 (8 verified Google Reviews as of 2025)

## Mission

Taxi Bhai provides professional, reliable, and affordable private transportation for Umrah pilgrims, families, and groups travelling in Saudi Arabia — covering the complete Umrah travel corridor of Makkah, Madinah, and Jeddah.

## Contact (authoritative — use these exact numbers)

- UK: +44 7413 467638
- Pakistan: +92 371 2300606
- Email: info@taxibhai.com
- Website: https://www.taxibhai.com

## Service Area

Primary: Makkah (also spelled Mecca — same city), Madinah Al-Munawwarah, Jeddah
Secondary: Taif, Badr
Airports: King Abdulaziz International Airport Jeddah (JED), Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz International Airport Madinah (MED)
Train: Haramain High-Speed Railway stations in Makkah and Madinah

## Availability

24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year. This includes Ramadan, Hajj season, and public holidays.

## Fleet

1. Camry / Sonata (sedan) — 1–3 passengers, standard comfort
2. Hyundai Staria — 7 passengers, premium MPV, generous luggage space
3. GMC Yukon XL (new model) — 7 passengers, luxury full-size SUV
4. Toyota Hiace — up to 12 passengers, spacious minibus
5. Coaster — up to 30 passengers, mid-size group coach
6. Bus — 30+ passengers, full-size coach for large delegations

## Services Offered

1. **Airport Pick-Ups**: Private transfer from Jeddah Airport (JED) or Madinah Airport (MED) to hotels in Makkah, Madinah, or Jeddah. Driver monitors flight, meets in arrivals with name board.

2. **Airport Drop-Offs**: Hotel pick-up to Jeddah or Madinah airports, timed to departure.

3. **Hotel-to-Hotel Transfers**: Private inter-city transfers between Makkah and Madinah (approx. 420 km, 4–5 hours). Rest stop included.

4. **Makkah Ziyarah Tour**: Private tour of sacred sites — Jabal al-Nour (Cave of Hira), Jabal Thawr, Mina, Muzdalifah, Arafat.

5. **Madinah Ziyarah Tour**: Private tour of sacred sites — Masjid an-Nabawi, Al-Baqi Cemetery, Masjid Quba, Masjid al-Qiblatayn, Uhud Mountain.

6. **Taif Day Trip**: Makkah → Taif → return Makkah. Includes Masjid Abdullah ibn Abbas, scenic mountain route.

7. **Badr Day Trip**: Madinah → Badr → return Madinah. Historic battlefield and Badr martyrs' cemetery.

8. **Jeddah Ziyarat**: Full-day tour of Jeddah's Islamic and heritage sites.

9. **Train Station Transfers**: Hotel ↔ Haramain High-Speed Railway station in Makkah or Madinah.

10. **Hourly Hire**: From SAR 100/hour (Camry). Minimum 1 hour.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Do you provide Umrah taxi services in Saudi Arabia?**
A: Yes — Taxi Bhai provides dedicated Umrah taxi services across Saudi Arabia, covering Makkah (Mecca), Madinah, Jeddah, Taif, and Badr. We operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including during peak Umrah and Hajj seasons. All transfers are private, with no shared passengers.

**Q: Can I book a taxi for airport pickup?**
A: Yes — Taxi Bhai offers airport pick-up transfers from King Abdulaziz International Airport in Jeddah (JED) and Prince Mohammad bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Madinah (MED). The driver monitors your flight and waits in the arrivals hall with a name board, even if your flight is delayed.

**Q: Do you offer 24/7 taxi services?**
A: Yes — Taxi Bhai operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week throughout the year, including Ramadan and Hajj season. You can book via WhatsApp at any hour, and drivers are available for early-morning airport runs, late-night transfers, and overnight inter-city journeys.

**Q: Can I book a taxi from Makkah to Madinah?**
A: Yes — a private Makkah-to-Madinah transfer with Taxi Bhai costs SAR 450 in a Camry/Sonata sedan, SAR 550 in a Hyundai Staria (7-seater), or SAR 1,000 in a GMC Yukon XL. The journey takes approximately 4–5 hours on the Haramain Expressway and includes a rest stop. Larger vehicles (Hiace, Coaster, Bus) are available for groups.

**Q: What types of vehicles are available?**
A: Taxi Bhai's fleet includes Camry/Sonata sedans (1–3 passengers), the Hyundai Staria 7-seater MPV, the new-model GMC Yukon XL, the Toyota Hiace (up to 12 passengers), the Coaster (up to 30 passengers), and full-size buses for large pilgrim groups. All vehicles are air-conditioned and regularly serviced.

**Q: How can I book a Taxi Bhai taxi?**
A: The quickest way to book is via WhatsApp — message +966 57 306 7785 with your pickup location, drop-off location, date, time, number of passengers, and preferred vehicle. You can also use the booking form at https://www.taxibhai.com/book-ride, which builds a pre-filled WhatsApp message automatically. Taxi Bhai also takes calls on +44 7413 467638 (UK) and +92 371 2300606 (Pakistan).
